images.title: The box for 23 × 14
images.purpose: Show the box method for one product: both numbers split into tens and ones along the top and down the side, four small products in the cells, two column sums and the total.
images.composition: One table in the middle of the frame with a header row, two rows of cells, a row of column sums and a total row, and one caption under it.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One table of 5 rows by 3 columns with dark #2B2B2B cell borders (3 px). Column widths: column 1 is 160 px (x 388 to 548), column 2 is 260 px (x 548 to 808), column 3 is 260 px (x 808 to 1068). Every row is 110 px tall: row 1 y 90 to 200, row 2 y 200 to 310, row 3 y 310 to 420, row 4 y 420 to 530, row 5 y 530 to 640. All text is centred in its cell in bold sans-serif (48 px). Row 1: the cell at column 1 is white and holds the sign ×; the cell at column 2 is filled teal #0072B2 with white text 20; the cell at column 3 is filled teal with white text 3. Row 2: the cell at column 1 is filled teal with white text 10; the cell at column 2 is filled amber #E69F00 with dark #1F2937 text 200; the cell at column 3 is filled amber with dark text 30. Row 3: the cell at column 1 is filled teal with white text 4; the cell at column 2 is filled amber with dark text 80; the cell at column 3 is filled amber with dark text 12. Row 4: the cell at column 1 is white and empty; the cell at column 2 is filled green #009E73 with white text 280; the cell at column 3 is filled green with white text 42. Row 5: the cell at column 1 is white and empty; columns 2 and 3 are joined into one cell (x 548 to 1068) filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with dark text 322. In all there are 14 cells on the picture: 3 in row 1, 3 in row 2, 3 in row 3, 3 in row 4 and 2 in row 5. Centred at x 728 and y 712 the caption 23 × 14 = 322 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (46 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a table with a number of rows or columns other than 5 rows and 3 columns, or a total cell that is not joined across columns 2 and 3
any cell that holds a number other than the one listed for it, or any cell with a different colour
images.takeaway: Split both numbers into tens and ones, multiply the parts in the four cells, add each column, then add the two sums: 280 and 42 make 322.
images.description: A box with 20 and 3 along the top and 10 and 4 down the side, the four cells 200, 30, 80 and 12, the column sums 280 and 42, and the total 322.
images.context: Concept image for The Box Method. It follows the idea of Nida's box in your maths book (parts of one number across the top, parts of the other down the side, column sums and a total) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: 23 and 14.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student say where each cell comes from (the top number times the side number) before reading the sums. The slip to watch: writing 10 × 20 as 20 instead of 200.

image_decisions.why: The box is the method: its four cells, two column sums and total make the small products and the adding visible, which words alone do not.
